validator_run.raw_output: raw exit 0 on the integrated SHA

review_notes.measured_live: Against the real gateway after the fix, --modelo gpt-5.6-luna reviews and catches the command injection with a concrete exploitation example. Before, the same call returned 400.
review_notes.stronger_than_omitempty: The Temperature field is gone from the litellm request struct entirely, so it cannot be serialised by accident. Sending 0 is refused by those models too; only omission works.
review_notes.pinned_test_updated_not_weakened: internal/llm/types_test.go had its expected value changed from 0.3 to 0 with a comment explaining the behaviour change. The reviewer checked the diff: the assertion is still there and still asserts.
review_notes.unreachability_verified_twice: The claim that openai, anthropic and ollama do not matter was confirmed independently by go list -deps ./cmd/aurumcode and by reading main.go -- only litellm.NewProvider is instantiated. Those three still forward temperature but are unreachable from this binary.
review_notes.real_mutation: The reviewer reintroduced the field in the actual worktree file, not in the script's sandbox copy, and all four subtests fell leaking the JSON with temperature in the body.
review_notes.declared_tradeoff: A user who needs an explicit temperature on litellm no longer has one. The card authorises always-omit and says so.
